knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A humming motor can mean a jammed impeller. The supply is turned off and the fault is referred, and the motor is not opened by an unlicensed person.
Cloudy water changes which readings apply, so the pH and sanitiser are checked first, and the plan decides any product.
The handbook describes a patch a bit wider than the opening, with eased corners, the maker's adhesive, and smoothing outwards from the centre. Household adhesives are not the method.

practicalCriteria: Fault checks are carried out in the stated order and recorded with a result each time
Electrical, gas and heater faults are referred without opening the enclosure or control
A liner patch follows the stated method, with the adhesive named by the maker and the patch kept dry while it sets
Cloudy water is recorded with the pH and sanitiser readings before any product decision
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Fault record for one supervised visit, with checks and changes
Patch record with location and adhesive, where a patch was made
Referral note for any electrical, gas or heater fault
stopWorkCriteria: Electrical enclosure or motor opened by an unlicensed person
Gas or heater control adjusted without the licence
Product added to fix cloudy water without the plan's authority
Liner repaired with a household cleaner or wire brush used on the surface
